name: pipeline_demo_rerun
purpose: TASKS 146 (the user, 30 Oct: 'Draai de demomoleculen opnieuw met versie 0.4'): benzene, phenanthrene and module 06's candidate through pipeline 0.4, one after the other into one folder, then the two truth reads; the demo page then shows one version (0.3 reproduced the first two to the bit, 0.4 changes only the record's provenance)

estimate.basis: the 0.1-0.3 runs on this laptop: benzene 0.1 h, phenanthrene 1.3 h, the candidate 3.7 h, and the two truth reads in seconds

memory.basis: a bound: each WSL step runs under probes/wsl_capped.sh at 8192 MB at most (benzene 6144); psi4 is given 4 GB and runs before it, not beside it; one molecule at a time
